items.title: Gabber’s involutivity theorem
items.label: ithm:gabber
items.correspondence: Current red statement scopes the theorem to M=A_n(k)/I with the quotient order filtration and states involutivity of sqrt(Ann gr M). The pinned Lean source proves this algebraic form in full; the manuscript cites Gabber and Singh–Kumar.
items.route: n/a in paper (citation). Lean follows Gabber / Singh-Kumar Prop 3.2 eq (3.3): order-Rees ring mod T^2 (square-zero central c), commutator = c*z with pi(z) = -{.,.}; Ore-localize the opposite ring at a minimal prime P; truncate by the two-block ideal to an Artinian local special fibre; choose a coefficient field (formal smoothness, char 0) and an m-adically adapted basis; trace of the z-action is 0 but equals dim*scalar, so scalar = 0 and -{f,g} in P; then sqrt J = intersection of minimal primes.
